scope: 20261015-rea-reuse only; operational success comes from actual readbacks, gates and independent receipts, never model narration

findings.observation: The first complex-field recipe used unsupported locator keys. The actual executor returned a binding_failure before field input; the model corrected the locator schema and completed. Both rejected attempts and their subsequent model requests remain in usage/full time.
A grouped widget inspection repeated the same site ID. The adapter rejected it; the model regrouped clicks and recovered. This is an actual tool error, included in full cost.

Model narration claimed fresh-page replay had succeeded immediately after complete_fields. Actual replay happens later in review_submit_batch. The program did perform the later real replay, draft validation and promotion, and audit uses those events. The premature narration is not evidence.

The model expanded the captured script even though native preparation required no complex recipe. The first-learning protocol explicitly required REA analysis; this extra evidence read and learning cost is retained, and does not imply REA is necessary for native fields.

Full CLI time was 110.64 seconds versus 68.25 for no-REA, despite six versus ten model requests and shorter tool time (4.82 versus 5.85 seconds). The remaining model/network/CLI interval was larger. No slow round was removed or rerun; no unsupported attribution to pure inference or network is made.

One observation per cell. Provider prompt cache and local machine load were uncontrolled; local CI also overlapped part of the model test. First-learning facts differ from the matched no-REA/reuse facts to validate parameterization. These limit causal and latency-stability claims.
